document.abstract: The Journal Award is given annually for the most outstanding paper originally published in the Journal of this Society during the preceding calendar year. It was established in 1933. It is my privilege to announce tonight on behalf of the Journal Award Committee that the Journal Award for 1944 has been made to John I. Crabtree, George T. Eaton, and Lowell E. Muehler for their paper entitled “The Removal of Hypo and Silver Salts from Photographic Materials as Affected by the Composition of the Processing Solutions,” published in the July, 1943, issue.
